transc:

Jaunts Pene well seasoned with Provisions but Palsy of

1030 am  Washn June 18th 1864
Dorothy June 18th to Maj Genl
Stahl period Genl Hunters letter of
June 9th is just received He
says he has directed you to
collect troops & take out an
yellow train but makes no requisition
of the kind of yellow period
You can take from Harp Ferry
such yellow as you think he
wants and the ordnance dept will
send to H Ferry any that
may be required there period It
is the duty of the Ordnance
officers of that dept to attend
to details signed Alden Chf Staff
